Model coordinates here follow the drawing (drawing-up = N, so the chained wall is run 0 'E' along the top); real compass orientation is not modeled. Both side walls read 11'-11" (left and right each labeled 11'-11" in pen).
Door 'DR 3'-0"' sits in the bottom wall. The 2'-11" dimension runs from the east (SE-corner) wall to the door's east jamb, so at = 2'-11" from the run-2 start corner to the near jamb.
Hinge recorded as 'near': the door leaf is drawn as a line rising from the east jamb into the room. Inferred from the drawing, not written.
No door height anywhere on the plan - h omitted so it builds as the 80" flagged DEFAULT.
Ceiling 9'-1" taken from 'CLG 9'-1" THRU-OUT' - applied to the whole studio.
Wall thickness and sill not stated; fields omitted so house defaults (4" / 48") apply. No windows, heaters, or bulkheads are drawn.
